name: LAGET DISCOVERY ONE PRO
why_interesting: Fully 3D-printed titanium gravel frameset with a documented 1.38 kg size-S frame, 45 mm clearance and UDH.

facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-S frame weight; included carbon fork and hardware are not stated to be part of the 1.38 kg figure
facts.frame: Fully 3D-printed titanium frame with carbon fork and UDH
facts.frame_material: 3D-printed titanium frame; exact titanium alloy grade is not published
facts.frame_construction: Fully 3D-printed unibody frame; brushed or sandblasted finish depending color
facts.stiffness_evidence: Exact-model retailer describes the printed high-strength titanium structure as strong and suitable for long-distance riding; no quantified stiffness protocol is published

observed_price.price_basis: Exact Discovery ONE PRO brushed-finish frameset listing; no cheaper option or variant selector was present

missing: Mainland warranty issuer and invoice handling for the exact Taobao listing
Independent measured stiffness or deflection result
Exact included-package weight beyond the stated frame weight
source_note: Official page lists the fully 3D-printed titanium frameset at CNY 21,900.
